## Safety checklist
- [ ] No new automatic transmit, beacon, digipeat or acknowledgement
- [ ] No service enabled/started automatically, no firmware flashing without explicit confirmation
- [ ] No `shell=True`, no secrets, personal data or machine-specific paths
- [ ] SPDX headers on new `.py`/`.sh` files
- [ ] Docs updated (MODULES.md / HARDWARE.md / CHANGELOG.md) if behaviour changed
